CustomField.label: Base URL
CustomField.description: Selects production or beta. Only the packaged Named Credentials are called. Any other value, including a raw https URL, is ignored and cannot receive the API token.
CustomField.inlineHelpText: Leave blank for production (Veleiro_API). Beta is selected by the Veleiro Setup screen, which writes the packaged Veleiro_API_Beta callout. A raw URL is not used.
